content: Constrain the scope of a specific communication The pur- pose of the attribute scope of meta-class VariableAccess is to constrain the scope of the corresponding communication. The main use-case for this ability is the development of a software-component where certain end-points of communication from or to the software-component are known to fulfill a certain constraint, e.g. execute within the same partition.
